name: Kayano Chika
source: A classmate of [url=http://vndb.org/c6702]Shiori's[/url]. She has a crush on him but accuses him of having a sister complex. Mostly because [url=http://vndb.org/c6698]Amane[/url] is very close to him and sometimes kisses him at school. She just wants him to act normal around his sisters. Her breasts are small but she's not overly concerned about it.
